- Next turn you are told which 4 letters those keys held, as an ALPHABETICALLY SORTED list. You are NOT told which letter came from which key. Overlap your chords cleverly to pin letters to keys.

LOCKS (optional, side score)
On any press turn you may lock letters onto keys you are sure of: +1 point if correct at that moment, -3 if wrong. You get no feedback on locks during the game. Each key can be locked only once, ever.

FINAL GUESS
You may end the game at any time by submitting your full guess. After turn 24 you MUST submit it. Your main score is how many of the 26 keys you guess correctly, judged against the arrangement at the moment you guess.

Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no other text.
To press: {"presses": ["L-pinky-top", "L-ring-home", "L-middle-bottom"]}
